expected_behavior: 调用 analyze_threat_incident 一次，交付与真实工具完全一致的 JSON；根据实时名单允许 fast_classification 或 five_source。五源若合同拒绝，必须返回 contract_failed 且没有 result。连接失败不算迁移通过。
check_method:
```javascript
const r = JSON.parse(context.response.assistant_text)
const outputs = context.archive.root.filter(e => e.type === 'tool/result')
  .flatMap(e => e.data.message.content).filter(b => b.type === 'tool-result' && !b.isError)
const toolText = outputs[0]?.content.filter(b => b.type === 'text').map(b => b.text).join('')
if (outputs.length !== 1 || JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(toolText)) !== JSON.stringify(r)) return false
return context.checks.called_tools.length === 1
  && context.checks.called_tools[0] === 'analyze_threat_incident'
  && r.incident_id === 'INC-20260915-000002' && ['fast_classification', 'five_source'].includes(r.route)
  && (r.route === 'fast_classification'
    ? r.status === 'completed' && r.llm_invoked === false && !!r.result
    : r.llm_invoked === true && !!r.input_sha256
      && ((r.status === 'completed' && /^passed/.test(r.validation?.status) && !!r.result)
        || (r.status === 'contract_failed' && r.validation?.status === 'failed' && !r.result)))
```
